tasks.design: Test native context-linked parking-record lookup and fixed-field citation population in enforcement {OPS_SYSTEM}. The tool drafts only from actual captured facts and the officer's chosen determination; retain complete officer review of that generated final document and explicit legal issue, with no automatic violation decision or saving on issue.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified observed facts may be entered again into fixed citation fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fixed-field mapping can remove repeated form population.
tasks.still_hard: Signs, entitlements, exceptions and actual evidence need officer judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The officer recognises a valid exception that a simple payment mismatch would miss.
tasks.altitude: Less field population; legal issuance authority remains with the officer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native field mapping can prepare a citation from verified facts without choosing a violation or issuing it.

assumptions: Provisional baseline only where fifteen points are actual repeated fixed-field population, not existing handheld autofill. Five of20 source points are repeated navigation; source validity checks remain. If already configured, both existing capabilities earn zero new credit.

Worker captures plate, country, location, time, sign/restriction evidence and actual observations in s1; parking-record owners supply dated entitlement/payment/restriction status. Missing or conflicting data requires manual clarification. No free image extraction or adverse decision inferred from a mismatch.

s5 is the existing officer's legal issuance check of the tool-generated final citation after it exists, not an added approval of the officer's own notes. Only fixed forms eligible for complete generation use s4; any officer-written free text must remain manual and be reweighted. Ordinary same-workspace saves are included unchanged; s6 is actual legal issue, not a routine save, at1 point with zero saving.
unknowns: How much native citation population already occurs?
Which actual fields need manual narrative?
research_questions: Can every generated field reconcile to captured facts without changing the officer's offence determination?

incremental.description: Maintain current citation layouts, source links and field-mapping checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact generated final warning/citation and recipient/location reviewed against evidence in s5; any edit voids approval

Actual observation, violation determination, full generated-document review and legal issue remain.

tasks.design: Configure citation-id links to the original evidence and actual hearing notice in {OPS_SYSTEM}/{DOCS}. Reduce repeat packet navigation while preserving evidence study, truthful testimony, court appearance and any assigned fresh follow-up notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hearing preparation can require finding scattered original records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence links can expose the original packet.
tasks.still_hard: The worker must accurately recall and explain actual observations under questioning.
tasks.human_edge: The witness states what was not observed rather than filling gaps.
tasks.altitude: Less hearing-packet navigation; court work remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: citation-linked original evidence can reduce hearing preparation navigation while testimony remains personal factual work.

assumptions: Provisional source20 includes four repeated locating points; evidence reading15, appearance60 and actual assigned records5 remain. Drop/reweight the record if another role owns it. No new witness statement or filing is invented.

Enforcement record owner supplies actual citation id, original evidence ids/timestamps and version; court supplies actual notice/time. Missing originals require manual retrieval. No model reconstructs memory or hearing outcome. Ordinary internal save earns zero saving; actual separate evidence submission must be mapped if assigned, with no saving assumed.
unknowns: Are original citation and hearing papers already linked?
research_questions: Can packet links preserve originals and distinguish later annotations?

incremental.description: Maintain citation-to-hearing source links and access.

tasks.design: Configure asset-specific instruction and supply-location links in enforcement equipment {OPS_SYSTEM}/{DOCS}. Retain actual condition inspection, counts, physical maintenance/replenishment and complete assigned records; ordinary internal saving stays unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicable handheld instructions or supply locations may require navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset-source links remove a small amount of locating work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset instruction links can reduce source navigation while physical equipment maintenance remains human.

assumptions: Provisional source10 includes one repeated locating point. Do not invent daily instruction reading if none occurs; remove/reweight that branch and claim no navigation saving. Existing native links earn no new credit.

Equipment owner supplies actual asset/model id, instruction revision and stock location. Worker physically counts and observes condition before recording. Missing instructions are obtained manually. Assigned internal records are split and retained; no new purchasing order or supplier send is assumed in maintaining existing assigned supplies.
unknowns: How often are instructions actually consulted and who owns stock records?

tasks.design: Configure actual incident/location links in dispatch {OPS_SYSTEM} for use alongside the radio. Save repeated context navigation while keeping heard facts, assessment, live radio responses and assigned written call notes human; no transcript or automated radio send is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Incident and restriction context may require several lookups.
tasks.enabler_now: Native incident-to-location links can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Radio ambiguity, urgency and actual site conditions require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The worker asks for a crucial missing location detail before acting.
tasks.altitude: Less incident-context navigation; dispatch communication stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native incident/location links can reduce dispatch-context navigation while live radio communication and assessment remain human.

assumptions: Provisional source15 includes three repeated navigation points. Dispatcher owns any actual structured incident id/location/time record; missing location or identifier is clarified manually, not extracted for free from radio. Existing call logging and links earn no new credit.

Live calls s1/s4 are actual conversations, not hidden tool messages. Actual assigned written call notes10 are split and fully retained, including ungated internal save. If another role owns all notes, drop/reweight that branch. No new report or extra send is invented.
unknowns: Can the field worker access an actual structured dispatch incident?
